rule: Floor 1 order: one story page (WelcomeScene, dungeon region), class pick, then HUD hidden (toolbar, status, inventory) with one movement line. The guidebook is dropped in the entrance room; picking it up flashes the intro page; closing it calls endIntro, which fades the status bar then the toolbar and inventory in over 2 s, logs one hero-info line and reveals floor-1 hidden doors. Floor 1 creates 8 pre-set mobs, drawn from a rotation of 3 rats and 1 snake, and no mob may spawn within an 8-cell field of view or 8-step walk of the entrance. Kill XP is rat 1 and snake 2, so the 8 mobs total 10 XP, which equals the level-1 threshold of 5 + 5 x level (derived; a champion roll, not read, could change EXP). Hit feedback: blood burst count min(9 x sqrt(damage / target HT), 9); flash 0.05 s. No shop before depth 6; the ghost quest offer (depth 2 to 4, chance 1 in (5 - depth), once per game) is the first NPC; services then arrive one band at a time (wandmaker after 6, blacksmith after 11, imp after 16). Timing is by depth, not minutes; the donor has no clock.
keep: HUD hidden until the first story beat is closed, then a short fade-in with one control line
one guidebook item that unlocks the guide pages on pickup
floor-1 pool sized so its kill XP equals the first level threshold
8-cell clear ring around the entrance for spawns
service introductions spread by depth band, one service at a time
hit feedback scaled by damage over target HT with a cap
change: our first story beat is the gladiator-ring win, so the HUD reveal fires on the first hit or first win, not on a book
our ring fight is many-vs-one with at most three attackers, so the pool and cap are sized for that
the way back up is a town-gate line instead of a locked stair message
all names, numbers and art are ours; no Evan text, sprites or sounds
look_test: Five minutes on a phone at 375 wide, via a style flag on the existing opening (look-test skill, no release rows). Show two versions side by side: (a) HUD hidden until the first story card closes, then a 2 s fade-in with one control line; (b) HUD on from the start. Start three weak enemies 8 cells out. Dom judges whether the first kill feels earned in (a) and whether the reveal is worth the wait. Check the blood-burst curve at 3 damage and at full target HT on an 8-HP enemy.
